verdict.rationale: Flagsmith ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.flagsmith.com) exposing the Admin API to AI assistants/agents, confirmed live via a runtime probe (401 requiring auth, not a failure), which enables natural-language operation through an MCP-compatible AI client, plus a CLI for terminal-based flag management. However, this is agent-mediated (via MCP client) rather than native NLP in the product itself, and there's no hands-on evidence of a full natural-language command actually being executed end-to-end through an AI assistant. Missing for 10: a demonstrated end-to-end natural-language interaction transcript, and independent (non-vendor) corroboration of the MCP server working with a real AI agent.
